analysis.equivalent: For successful allocations and synchronization-plan outcomes only; extra checkpoint copies may allocate.
analysis.distinguishing_input: Batch starts with N resources, creates resource index N, then uses it again in that batch.
analysis.expected_behavior: Skip journaling new resources; rollback removes them by resizing to N.
